title: Act 2 - Chapter 5: Morty & the Fog Badge (Ecruteak City, Burned Tower & Bell Tower)
synopsis: Trek north through Route 37 to historic Ecruteak City. Obtain the Squirtbottle from the Ranger, receive the Light and Dark Stones from Champion Alder at the Kimono Dance Theater, and use the Golbat Boot to navigate the subterranean chasms of the Burned Tower to locate Gym Leader Morty. Master the shifting skull platform maze of Ecruteak Gym to defeat Morty in a 5 vs 5 duel and earn the Fog Badge.
